meta.assumptions: Single, tax class I, no children, no church tax, statutory health insurance with average Zusatzbeitrag (2.5 %), 2025 tax and contribution rules. Includes the commuting allowance.
meta.sources: BBSR asking rents 2025 per district; Zensus 2022 rents of recent movers per municipality (table 5000H-0009), 1 km and 100 m grids (Destatis); Mikrozensus 2022 utilities and heating (Destatis). Wages: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, workplace, 31.12.2024.
